zones.name: Ecological Cool Base
zones.description: Ecological Cool Base (day): 13,206 km² in 2025 (24% of the study area), mean observed day anomaly -6.40 °C. Main warming drivers: Spring green-up (+0.05 °C), Built-up fraction (+0.03 °C). Main cooling drivers: Built-up index (NDBI) (-4.01 °C), Vegetation (NDVI) (-0.84 °C), Albedo (-0.68 °C). Largest shares in Muzaffarnagar (20%), Meerut (18%), Bulandshahr (17%).

recommendations.rationale: In the final day model, raising NDVI by 0.06 in every cell (zone median 0.38 → 0.45), i.e. greening within the existing land covers is associated with a mean LST change of -0.84 °C over the zone's 13,206 cells (replicate range -0.93 to -0.68 °C). The 3- and 15-cell neighbourhood means are recomputed (distances held fixed): 13,667 cells outside the zone have changed neighbourhood inputs (mean LST change -0.04 °C over them, cells whose prediction does not move included). This is a model-based ceteris-paribus estimate, not a causal effect. The target is the feasibility bound (the zone's own 90th/10th percentile, or the maximum step).

In the final day model, lowering cropland by 19 percentage points in every cell (zone median 98% → 79%) is associated with a mean LST change of -0.25 °C over the zone's 13,206 cells (replicate range -0.57 to -0.15 °C). The 3- and 15-cell neighbourhood means are recomputed (distances held fixed): 13,667 cells outside the zone have changed neighbourhood inputs (mean LST change +0.05 °C over them, cells whose prediction does not move included).
